Subtract 260 days from 1887-11-10.  
1887 is not a leap year.  
From 1887-11-10 back 260 days:  
First go back 10 days to 1887-10-31, then back 250 more days.  
250 days before 1887-10-31:  
Go to 1887-01-01 is 273 days earlier (Jan–Oct 31 = 304 days in year? Let's compute exactly).  

Better: Count days in 1887 before Nov 10: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 = 304 days. So Nov 10 is day 314 of year.  
260 days earlier: 314 − 260 = day 54 of 1887.  
Day 54 of 1887: Jan 31 (31 days), Feb 28 (total 59), so day 54 is Feb 23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1887-02-23
